name: Barbell Guillotine Press
steps: Lie on the bench, plant your feet and take a wide overhand grip with your thumbs around the bar.
Set your shoulder blades against the bench, brace your trunk and unrack the bar over your upper chest.
With your elbows wider than in a standard press, lower the bar toward your upper chest just below your collarbones.
Reverse smoothly before touching your neck and press the bar straight back up to full extension.
tips: Use a conservative weight and stay well within the range your shoulders tolerate comfortably.
Always keep your thumbs wrapped around the bar and stop well clear of your throat.
